messages.subject: Installing problem breedR
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I have problem with installing breedR. It seems there is nothing on this page:
https://famuvie.github.io/breedR/bin/windows/contrib/4.4

Any suggestions? The exact error message below. And I don't have admin permission to my computer due to organizational restrictions.

I have:
R version 4.4.0 (2024-04-24 ucrt)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 Running under: Windows 10 x64 (build 19045) Matrix products: default

The error message:
> source("http://famuvie.github.io/breedR/src/setup_repo.R") > install.packages('breedR') Installing package into ‘C:/Users/03139625/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.4’ (as ‘lib’ is unspecified) Warning in install.packages : unable to access index for repository https://famuvie.github.io/breedR/bin/windows/contrib/4.4: cannot open URL 'https://famuvie.github.io/breedR/bin/windows/contrib/4.4/PACKAGES' Package which is only available in source form, and may need compilation of C/C++/Fortran: ‘breedR’ installing the source package ‘breedR’ trying URL 'https://famuvie.github.io/breedR/src/contrib/breedR_0.12-5.tar.gz' Content type 'application/gzip' length 4922621 bytes (4.7 MB) downloaded 4.7 MB * installing *source* package 'breedR' ... ** using staged installation ** libs Error in system(paste(MAKE, p1(paste("-f", shQuote(makefiles))), "compilers"), : 'CreateProcess' failed to run 'C:\rtools42\usr\bin\make.exe -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-44~1.0/etc/x64/Makeconf" -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-44~1.0/share/make/winshlib.mk <http://winshlib.mk>" compilers' * removing 'C:/Users/03139625/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.4/breedR' Warning in install.packages : installation of package ‘breedR’ had non-zero exit status  The downloaded source packages are in ‘C:\Users\03139625\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpuQmHLp\downloaded_packages’
Best regards,
Jaanika Edesi
Visiting researcher
Natural Resources Institute LUKE, Finland
